# HELP loxilb_ai_admission_anomalies_total Accounting anomalies in the capacity gate, process-wide: underflow (a release found its counter at zero), unknown_permit (an executing permit with no pool), tenant_table_full (a request whose tenant found the pool's tenant table full and shared the last slot with the other tenants past it) and h2_deny_headers (an HTTP/2 refusal had more headers than its frame holds; the stream was reset instead). underflow, unknown_permit and h2_deny_headers are defects; tenant_table_full means more tenants than the table holds are active on one pool.

# HELP loxilb_ai_admission_decisions_total Gate decisions per pool and reason: admitted, capacity_shed (429), no_healthy_capacity (503), observe_would_shed (admitted in observe mode where enforce would have refused, counted at each ceiling that would have refused it), bypass_non_inference (not an inference request, no unit taken), queued (parked to wait for a unit, once per park: a woken request that goes back to its place is the same park), queue_full (429, the queue at its depth), queue_timeout (504, waited the whole window), cancelled (the client left while waiting), drained (the pool or the process stopped taking work while it waited), observe_would_queue (admitted in observe mode where enforce would have parked it), draining (503, the process is draining for maintenance), tenant_share (429, the tenant holds its share of the ceiling or of the queue), shed (429 admission_shed, a sheddable request refused at a ceiling or evicted from the queue by band policy).

# HELP loxilb_ai_fc_band_total Inference requests of the capacity gate per service, by priority band (the request's class: critical, standard, sheddable) and outcome. Four outcomes are terminal, one per request: admitted (took a capacity unit), shed (429 admission_shed: a sheddable request refused at a ceiling, or evicted from the queue for a higher band, by band policy), expired (504 admission_queue_timeout: its wait window ended), cancelled (its client left while it waited). queued is not an end: it counts parks, once per park (a woken request that goes back to its place is the same park). A request refused for another reason (queue full, tenant share, no healthy capacity, a drain) is counted in loxilb_ai_admission_decisions_total only. Fifteen series for every service with an AI-gateway pool, zero included.

# HELP loxilb_ai_key_store_circuit_open 1 while the key store's data-path circuit is open or half-open: cache misses are refused without contacting the store, quota reads serve their last store-confirmed value. Opens after LLB_AI_KEY_LOOKUP_CIRCUIT_FAILURES consecutive failures, admits one probe after LLB_AI_KEY_LOOKUP_CIRCUIT_COOLDOWN_MS, and closes on the probe's success. It stays 1 after the store recovers until a cache miss runs that probe; a steady 1 with no miss traffic is not an outage. Independent of store_reachable, which the snapshot refresher reports.
# TYPE loxilb_ai_key_store_circuit_open gauge
loxilb_ai_key_store_circuit_open 0

# HELP loxilb_pd_admission_overflow_shed_total Total requests shed (retriable 429) by the per-EP admission layer because every healthy prefill EP was at the in-flight cap AND its parked FIFO was full (overflow valve; the only reachable shed when queueing is enabled). Distinct from loxilb_pd_admission_shed_total, which counts sheds with queueing disabled.
# TYPE loxilb_pd_admission_overflow_shed_total counter
loxilb_pd_admission_overflow_shed_total 0
# HELP loxilb_pd_admission_queued_total Total requests PARKED (held, not shed) on a per-EP FIFO by the per-EP admission layer (hold-don't-drop). Distinct from global total-inflight valve.
# TYPE loxilb_pd_admission_queued_total counter
loxilb_pd_admission_queued_total 0
# HELP loxilb_pd_admission_shed_total Total requests shed (retriable 429) by the per-EP admission layer : every healthy prefill EP at the in-flight cap with no parked-FIFO room. Distinct from global total-inflight valve.
# TYPE loxilb_pd_admission_shed_total counter
loxilb_pd_admission_shed_total 0
